Subject: Humble request regarding the conduct of a separate technical examination for the post of Food Safety Officer. ‎ ‎ ‎To, ‎ ‎The Honorable Secretary, Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC), Prayagraj. ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎Sir, ‎ ‎I respectfully submit that the Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission currently fills the post of Food Safety Officer through the Combined State/Upper Subordinate Services (PCS) examination. ‎ ‎The post of Food Safety Officer is essentially a technical role, requiring in-depth knowledge of subjects such as Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Agricultural Science, Biochemistry, Veterinary Science, etc. In many states across the country, as well as under the Central Government (FSSAI), a separate technical examination is conducted for this post; this exam primarily focuses on technical subjects alongside a limited General Knowledge (GK) component. ‎ ‎Under the current system, since recruitment for this post takes place via the general PCS examination, many qualified and technically proficient candidates are unable to compete in a manner that reflects their subject-specific expertise. This may compromise the objective of selecting the best expert candidates for this crucial technical position. ‎ ‎Therefore, I humbly request you to consider—keeping in mind the nature and responsibilities of the Food Safety Officer post—conducting a separate technical examination for this role, similar to the practices of the Central Government and other states. This would ensure the selection of qualified candidates with subject expertise and further strengthen the state's food safety system. ‎ ‎It is hoped that the Commission will give positive consideration to this humble request, bearing in mind the public interest and the broader interests of food safety. ‎ ‎Thank you. ‎ ‎
